provenance: George Knapp obtained originals from Russian Ministry of Defense, Moscow, 1993. Translations released publicly via KLAS-TV/8NewsNow/Mystery Wire. First public release of original witness statements.
event_location: Belokorovichi/Usovo/Korosten area, Zhitomir Oblast, Ukrainian SSR

claims.claim: Multiple independent Soviet military witnesses observed unidentified bright luminous objects above village of Usovo, Ukrainian SSR on October 4, 1982 between 19:10 and 21:38
Objects displayed shape-changing behavior: reforming from ellipsis to line, separating into smaller objects, merging, appearing and disappearing
Objects moved at high speed, changed direction rapidly, and displayed no accompanying sound
Vehicle steering wheel and front wheels experienced unexplained vibration/trembling during UFO observation, verified mechanically sound by two officers
claims.significance: Electromagnetic interference with vehicle consistent with global UFO vehicle effect reports

claims.claim: Radio interference in LW and MW frequencies occurred during observation, with no high-voltage lines in area to explain it
At 21:37, all displays on communication system at MU 52035 spontaneously illuminated, control code combination appeared on ARI tape at 21:38, 'message GP' recorded automatically
Post-event testing of affected apparatus found NO defects; equipment functioning normally

Witness Katzman himself hypothesized the electronic event was caused by 'a powerful impulse on the apparatus power system' and noted the apparatus had a weak power system with prior fuse failure in July 1982
claims.significance: Contradicts Knapp testimony that Russians ruled out power surge

claims.claim: Objects appeared at altitudes ranging from 30m (forest edge level) to 5-7 km, with nearest approach of 1-2 km to witnesses
Light colors described consistently across witnesses: bright-golden, pale-yellow, reddish, dark-cherry, changing/twinkling

inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.existing_claim: UFO activated launch sequence for nuclear missiles
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.actual_document_evidence: Spontaneous illumination of communication system displays; codes identified as 'service signals on the control desk'
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.assessment: The primary source documents describe communication system anomaly, not missile launch activation

inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.actual_document_evidence: Documented timeline spans 19:10 to 21:38 = approximately 2 hours 28 minutes
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.assessment: Possible additional unreleased documents extend timeline, or approximate rounding

inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.existing_claim: Officers could not stop launch sequence
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.actual_document_evidence: No mention of inability to stop any system. Apparatus tested normally afterward
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.assessment: Not supported by released primary source documents

inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.existing_claim: This was not a power surge (Knapp testimony)
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.actual_document_evidence: Witness Katzman explicitly hypothesizes: 'I suppose that this effect can take place as a result of the influence of a powerful impulse on the apparatus power system'
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.assessment: Direct contradiction - witness suggests power surge, Knapp says Russians ruled it out

inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.existing_claim: Missiles fired up and appeared ready to be launched
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.actual_document_evidence: Communication displays illuminated. No mention of missiles, launch systems, or weapons in any witness statement
inconsistencies_with_existing_evidence.assessment: Significant escalation from what documents actually describe

consistencies_with_existing_evidence.existing_claim: 'Spontaneous illumination of all displays' (Sokolov's words per Knapp)
consistencies_with_existing_evidence.document_evidence: Katzman uses exact phrase: 'spontaneous illumination of all displays'
consistencies_with_existing_evidence.assessment: Confirmed - exact phrase match validates document-testimony connection

consistencies_with_existing_evidence.existing_claim: UFO split into pieces, merged back together
consistencies_with_existing_evidence.document_evidence: Multiple witnesses describe separating objects, balls detaching, lights reforming
Katzman: testing per technical map showed no defects

consistencies_with_existing_evidence.existing_claim: UFOs knocked out car engines (Sokolov to Knapp)
consistencies_with_existing_evidence.document_evidence: Lipezki: vehicle steering/wheel vibration effects during observation
consistencies_with_existing_evidence.assessment: Partially consistent - vehicle effects confirmed but not engine failure
